info.name: Pure Web Service 524 activities journals API

params.name: q
params.description: Free text search string using Lucene query syntax. Read more...

params.name: fields
params.description: Limit the fields included in the response. E.g. 'nameVariants.nameVariant' will only return the name variants. Read more...

params.name: order
params.description: Specify the ordering of content in the result. Default: ID ascending. Read more...

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Choose the directionality of the result. If set, this will override direction on 'Order'. Read more about order elements and direction here: Read more...

params.name: locale
params.description: Enter the desired locale. E.g. 'en_GB' will only return the English text strings. Read more...

params.name: fallbackLocale
params.description: Fallback locale string. Syntax is 'Locale1=>Locale2' to map Locale1 to Locale2. E.g. 'da_DK=>en_GB'. Locale1 must be equal to the locale provided in the locale string. Read more...

params.name: rendering
params.description: HTML rendering formats. If rendering formats are specified, the content will be returned in these formats instead of XML. If XML is also wanted, it can be included using the fields parameter. Read more...

params.name: linkingStrategy
params.description: Specify the linking strategy to use when creating HTML renderings. Read more...

params.name: returnUsedContent
params.description: If 'true', the IDs of the content used to create HTML renderings are returned as part of the result. Read more...

params.name: navigationLink
params.description: Include navigation links for paging and content. Default: true. Read more...

params.name: size
params.description: Enter the number of results per window. Default: 10. Read more...

params.name: offset
params.description: Enter the offset into the total result set where items should be returned from. Default: 0. Read more...

params.name: page
params.description: Enter the desired page number. Read more...

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Enter the desired number of results per page. Read more...

items.docs: Lists all journals in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the journals returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

Lists journals in the Pure instance, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an XML document is posted with the request. The XML document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options. For documentation of the XML format see Journal documentation.
Lists all orderings available to the journal endpoint. These values can be used by the order parameter.
Lists all renderings available to the journal endpoint. These values can be used by the rendering parameter.
